summary.notes: Pentagon_jbook fired on all 6 J-Book-grounded claims. Key catch: PE 0207448F (C2ISR Tactical Data Link) is UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR — relevant to TDL/Link 16 narrative but downgraded to MODERATE because (a) TDL is ~1.9% of FY23 revenue, and (b) the broader Link 16 / JADC2 ecosystem spans many PEs beyond this one. The PE 1206410SF cluster shows the canonical PWSA divergence (Transport Layer T3 UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, with replacement_program=SDN/Starshield), but LHX is NOT a prime on the unfunded Transport Layer T3 — LHX is on the FUNDED_STEADY Tracking Layer T3 sibling. AJRD-anchored missile defense + hypersonics + propulsion PEs all FUNDED_STEADY at 2024-09-01 cutoff. For a diversified prime of LHX's scale ($82.6B lifetime federal contracts, 41 UEIs, 76% USG revenue), the J-Book divergence signal is weak: the framework correctly resists a SEVERE call on the JADC2/Link 16 narrative given materiality + portfolio breadth. NOTE: pentagon_jbook corpus is hand-extracted FY26 books, so historical FY-by-FY funding for pre-2024 PEs returns NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE in many cases; status_declared fields used as primary signal where available.
